subject: Mongolia
note: Hand-curated research for a Geographica episode about Mongolia. Claims are cited to a pinned Wikipedia revision (trusted_secondary). The article’s own wording excludes Western Sahara from the "most sparsely populated sovereign state" claim, and the episode keeps the "sovereign state" wording. China is a flagged country in the map data and is only labelled, not highlighted.

claims.text: Mongolia is a landlocked country in East Asia, bordered by Russia to the north and China to the south.
It covers 1,564,116 square kilometres, making it the 18th-largest country in the world and the second-largest landlocked nation after Kazakhstan.
With a population of 3.5 million, Mongolia is the world’s most sparsely populated sovereign state, excluding Western Sahara.
Mongolia is known as the "Land of the Eternal Blue Sky" because it has over 250 sunny days per year.
